clayresearch.delta: Integrated BASE planning must keep language semantics, build reproducibility, bootstrap provenance and compiler-diversity trust as separate dimensions. Self-hosting is a strengthening path, not an implicit semantic primitive.

frank.delta: No Frank-specific compiler primitive is justified. Frank remains a later real application/handoff target after the general compiler/runtime path is stable.

gwt.delta: Compiler bootstrap identity/provenance does not alter GWT selection, broadcast, receiver-use or re-entry semantics.

emergenz.delta: Reproducible/self-hosted compiler behavior is build evidence, not functional or causal emergence evidence.

claycode.delta: Do not make full self-hosting an unstated BASE/APP-06 requirement. First close strict parser + generic function/control/data/error/runtime surfaces, then compile a Clay-authored APP-06 microtool with Stage1. Track semantic receipt, build-environment receipt and artifact identity separately. Attempt Stage2/Stage3 self-host only after the APP-06 slice is stable.

hyperposition.delta: Alternative frontend/backend/compiler paths may coexist during research, but any selected release stage must pin one explicit semantic/compiler/artifact identity.

claygraph.delta: Bootstrap/build lineage can be represented and queried in ClayGraph, but graph activation/proximity cannot establish compiler trust or artifact equivalence.

unifieddb.delta: Bootstrap receipts may need durable semantic identity, compiler/runtime identity, build-environment identity and output-artifact lineage in UnifiedDB/replay state. No physical-store merge conclusion follows.

harness.delta: Later H2/H3 differential runs should pin compiler/runtime/build identities separately from ProgramSemanticId; byte-identical rebuild, semantic-equivalent execution and diverse compiler/backend agreement must not be collapsed into one oracle.

ancestry_warning: Project-internal cross-branch agreement shares architecture ancestry and is not independent replication.
